g.text: Figure 1. Distribution of starting wage rates

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #444444

g.text: Card & Krueger (1994) | Reconstruction from the course survey data
Each distribution excludes missing wages. Bins are [4.20, 4.30), [4.30, 4.40), ...; final bin is $5.50 and above.
Tick labels show bin midpoints except the upper tail. Bin edges and tail grouping are explicit reconstruction choices.
